## The Super-est Food

### ORGANIC

As Canada’s first mushroom company to be certified organic we grow our mushrooms without pesticides.

### MAIN COURSE ENERGY

Rich, salty, naturally umami, meaty—it’s easy to serve our mushrooms as the main when they taste
this good!

### GOOD FOR YOU

*Brag alert* Vitamins, antioxidants, amino acids, fiber, protein (gulp) cholesterol free, low cal,
and tasty to boot.

### HARVESTED WITH LOVE

Grown with passion and precision, our mushrooms add a touch of quality that makes every bite a
delight.

### MUSH LOVE
### Since '61

From a family farm in Leamington, Ontario, to top ultra-fresh mushroom slinger across North America
and Japan—all for the love of mushrooms.

[ Our Story ][19]

### MUSHROOMS ARE SUPER SUSTAINABLE

Less water, waste, land, and energy are needed to grow our beautiful little shroomies. Sustainable,
nutritious, and delicious? I guess our fungi can have it all.

## [Florida Woodpeckers: Photos & Identification Guide to Common Species][65]

May 30, 2026
[ [Florida Woodpeckers][Florida Woodpeckers] ][66]

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

Each species is described with a focus on identification features and natural history to assist
birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

[Read more][67]

Categories [Animal Lists][68], [Birds][69]

# AUSTIN: Orchid Mycology Walk

Join us for a guided nature walk to observe the **Glass Mountain Crested Coralroot** (*Bletia
nitida*)—a threatened, mycoheterotrophic orchid that obtains nutrients through fungal parasitism
rather than photosynthesis. We will also see our state mushroom Devil’s Cigar or *Chorioactis
geaster* which is also fruiting after the recent rains! We will be collecting it for further
research.

**📅 Saturday, July 25, 2026 🕛 9:00 a.m. 💜 $15+ Donation**

[ Guest Tickets ][140]

## Our mission is to strengthen the conservation, research, and study of Fungi in Central Texas

We are a [member-supported][141], volunteer-run group of united Central Texans dedicated to working
with fungi. Fungi are foundational species for nearly all terrestrial life on Earth—critical links
between the health, stability, and abundance of the soil, plants, and fresh water on which human and
animal life depends. The Central Texas Mycological Society is committed to bringing forth the
recognition of mycology and the Fungal Kingdom as a beneficial ally in the effort to restore and
sustain the resilience of the natural world.

[ Get Map ][142]
[ Volunteer ][143]

SporeCorps is our **indoor cultivation and community lab program** — a hands-on space for curious
minds to explore the science, art, and discipline of growing fungi. SporeCorps teaches indoor STEM
methods in a supportive, futuristic, DIY-lab environment. Join us both online and in-person in labs
in Austin and San Antonio. [Contact us][144] if you want us to teach a class.

## Join the SporeCorps

# AUSTIN: Orchid Mycology Walk

Join us for a guided nature walk to observe the **Glass Mountain Crested Coralroot** (*Bletia
nitida*)—a threatened, mycoheterotrophic orchid that obtains nutrients through fungal parasitism
rather than photosynthesis. We will also see our state mushroom Devil’s Cigar or *Chorioactis
geaster* which is also fruiting after the recent rains! We will be collecting it for further
research.

**📅 Saturday, July 25, 2026 🕛 9:00 a.m. 💜 $15+ Donation**

[ Guest Tickets ][140]

## Our mission is to strengthen the conservation, research, and study of Fungi in Central Texas

We are a [member-supported][141], volunteer-run group of united Central Texans dedicated to working
with fungi. Fungi are foundational species for nearly all terrestrial life on Earth—critical links
between the health, stability, and abundance of the soil, plants, and fresh water on which human and
animal life depends. The Central Texas Mycological Society is committed to bringing forth the
recognition of mycology and the Fungal Kingdom as a beneficial ally in the effort to restore and
sustain the resilience of the natural world.

[ Get Map ][142]
[ Volunteer ][143]

SporeCorps is our **indoor cultivation and community lab program** — a hands-on space for curious
minds to explore the science, art, and discipline of growing fungi. SporeCorps teaches indoor STEM
methods in a supportive, futuristic, DIY-lab environment. Join us both online and in-person in labs
in Austin and San Antonio. [Contact us][144] if you want us to teach a class.

## Champ Fungi was established in 2002.

### The initial business activity was button mushroom farming.

Today the Champ-Fungi group of companies is a diversified group of companies with activities in the
cultivation of button mushrooms, Shitake and related “Asian” mushrooms, High-density baby leaf
production, hydroponics and fresh food processing. In addition, we cultivate, pack, ship, distribute
all througout our our sales offices in South East Asia, from farm to shelf or plate in less than 24
hours.

### Substrates

We produce our own substrates for Shiitake, Eringy and as well as other mushrooms.

### Cultivation

Our cultivation methods are based on a “controlled environment” either in enclosed growing houses or
closed greenhouses in order to have a stable supply of produce and mushrooms as well as minimizing
the use of herbicides.

### Sales & Distribution

We cultivate, harvest, pack and distribute within 24 hours in order to provide a fresh product.

all througout our our sales offices in South East Asia, from farm to shelf or plate in less than 24
hours.

We produce our own substrates for Shiitake, Eringy and as well as other mushrooms.

### Cultivation

Our cultivation methods are based on a “controlled environment” either in enclosed growing houses or
closed greenhouses in order to have a stable supply of produce and mushrooms as well as minimizing
the use of herbicides.

### Sales & Distribution

We cultivate, harvest, pack and distribute within 24 hours in order to provide a fresh product.

How do I pay for Indonesian company reports?
Search for a company, add reports to your cart, proceed to checkout, and pay securely by credit

AML, and cross-border compliance checks.
How do I remove my company from Companies House Indonesia?
We don’t manually add or remove records. Data is synced with official registries.

# FOOD SERVICE DISTRIBUTOR & INDUSTRIAL INGREDIENT SUPPLIER

# Clover Specialties Mushroom Supplier

Welcome to Clover Specialties, your trusted wholesale mushroom supplier and importer, processor and
distributor of gourmet and industrial food ingredients.

Our range of products include high-quality functional and culinary mushrooms, frozen porcini,
truffle oils, vanilla beans, and more, making us a comprehensive mushroom and food ingredient
supplier for food service, food manufacturers and supplement manufacturers.

For food service, we offer black and white truffle oils, pumpkinseed oil, pistachio oil, walnut and
hazelnut oils, vanilla beans, vanilla extracts, vanilla pastes, saffron, whole peppercorns including
Szechuan, Timut, pink and green peppercorn in bags, jars and bulk boxes.
In addition to vanilla extracts, we also offer almond extract, coffee extract, lemon, orange and
lime extracts, maple extract, and peppermint extract.

We offer organic and non-organic vanilla tahitensis and  vanilla planifolia black/gourmet vanilla
beans from Madagascar and Papua New Guinea (PNG) in bulk, 1 pound, 8 ounce and 4-ounce vacuum packed
pouches.  Should you wish custom packs, please contact us at (310) 329-3280 or
info@cloverspecialties.com and ask for Ruth.

For food manufacturers and supplement makers, we offer a of USDA organic and conventional functional
and culinary mushrooms in whole, slices, powder, dices, kibbles and extract powder. We have many of
these mushrooms in stock for immediate shipment 1-lb bags, boxes, and pallets. We also offer
pre-order for container quantities. Our growing list of mushrooms includes Shiitake, Porcini,
Chanterelle, Trumpet, Oyster, Morel, Reishi, Lion's Mane, Chaga, Cordyceps, Turkey Tail, Snow fungus
(tremella fuciformis), Maitake and more.

Our food facility is third-party audit certified to GFSI Standards consistently scoring higher than
90% every year. We are also Kosher for most products and are USDA organic certified for a number of
products.

As a US based food facility and warehouse, we arrange ground or expedited shipments using UPS,
FedEx, or various third-party LTL or FTL carriers, including temperature conrolled carriers, giving
you transit times and cost options. We also use the these carriers for Canadian shipments, and for
your convenience, use our own customs broker or yours.

As your go-to mushroom distributor, we offer not only quality products but also the convenience of
mushroom wholesale options. Whether you're a chef, culinary enthusiast, or part of the food
industry, Clover Specialties is here to meet your needs with precision and reliability.

Explore our inventory and discover the world of gourmet and industrial food ingredients with our
premium dried mushrooms, truffle oils, vanilla beans, spices, extracts, and more. Trust us to be
your dedicated industrial food ingredient and mushroom supplier, providing the finest products and
service in the industry.

## Our Customers

##### We supply distributors, manufacturers, and producers all over the United States and Canada.

## Our Products

##### We have an inventory of dried mushrooms, frozen porcini, truffles, oils, extracts, spices, and
##### more for immediate delivery.

Welcome to FungiAtlas.com – your online Mushroom Guide. Explore detailed profiles of edible,
inedible, poisonous, medicinal, and psychoactive mushrooms with photos and identification tips. Use
our [Mushroom ID][17] tool to upload your own pictures and get help recognizing wild species safely.
Discover how to identify fungi in nature, learn about their habitats, and share your passion with a
global community of mushroom enthusiasts.

### Bringing Fresh Ideas to Healthy Living!

Established in 1996, Guan’s Mushroom is a leading grower and distributor of fresh specialty
mushrooms in North America, with three farms in California and five distribution centers located in
San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York, West Grove and Toronto.

As a company, we value integrity, customer service and innovation. We strive to reflect these values
in the products we deliver and the services we provide. We offer a broad line of specialty
mushrooms, focusing on safety and efficiency in all aspects of production to ensure freshness and a
higher quality product.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search

## About Herbal Treasure

**Herbal Treasure** is a medicinal mushroom and wellness OEM/ODM manufacturer based in Fujian,
China. We support global B2B partners with end-to-end services—from formulation support and
ingredient sourcing to manufacturing, packaging, and export logistics. Our team of 130+
professionals operates a 20,000+ m² facility with capabilities across powders, capsules, tablets,
gummies, solid drinks, liquids (drops), and extract pastes. With clients in 40+ countries/regions,
we are built for reliable scale, consistent quality, and on-time delivery. Typical production lead
time is 15–35 days depending on formula and packaging. We help brands launch and grow with strong
documentation, robust QC, and flexible private-label and custom development options.

## Why Choose Us ?

At Herbal Treasure, quality is at the heart of everything we do. Our commitment to excellence is
reflected in the rigorous standards we uphold across every stage of production. We adhere to the
highest international certifications, ensuring the safety, purity, and efficacy of our products.

### Global Certifications

Our products meet international regulatory requirements, holding certifications such as GMP (Good
Manufacturing Practice), FDA compliance, and Organic Certification, ensuring they meet the highest
industry standards.

### Strict Quality Control

From sourcing to final production, every batch undergoes stringent testing for purity, potency, and
consistency. We use advanced analytical instruments, including liquid chromatography (LC), gas
chromatography (GC), and graphite furnace atomic absorption spectrometry (GFAAS), to guarantee the
absence of contaminants and to verify active ingredients.

### Third-Party Testing

In addition to our in-house testing, we work with trusted third-party laboratories to provide
additional validation of our products' quality, ensuring full transparency and compliance with
global standards.

### From Bulk to Market: Precisely Packaging Cannabis for Global Markets

HYTN specializes in the processing of cannabis products to meet the highest GMP standards. Our

* Final Packaged Goods - Jars

* Bulk Packaging - Bags

### From Source to Solution: Crafting High-Quality APIs for Clinical Applications

HYTN excels in the fabrication of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), ensuring they meet the
highest standards of purity and efficacy. Our capabilities in this area include:

mushrooms. Our capabilities in this area include:
* Final Packaged Goods - 1 g Sachet
* Bulk Packaging - Bags

HYTN specializes in creating high-quality consumer cannabis products, ensuring consistency, safety,
and satisfaction. Our capabilities in this area include:
* Nano Emulsions

## SCIENCE-BACKED BENEFITS

COGNITIVE HEALTH

Lion’s Mane (Hericium erinaceus) and Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum s.l.) have a rich history of
traditional use spanning millennia, where they are revered for their health benefits properties.
Modern clinical research is increasingly validating these historical applications. Lion’s Mane has
demonstrated potential in stimulating Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) production, crucial for neuronal
health and cognitive function, while Reishi’s exhibit adaptogenic and immunomodulatory effects. 

 

When consumed regularly in as whole mushrooms encompassing the complete range of bioactive
compounds, these organisms have shown promise in supporting various aspects of cognition, including
memory, focus, mood and overall brain health. M2 leverages this scientific understanding, offering
both individual species and custom, proprietary blends designed to optimize cognitive health .

DIGESTIVE HEALTH

Whole mushrooms are a rich source of both soluble and insoluble fiber and both beta glucans and
chitin, 2 major carbohydrates found in all mushrooms are known as prebiotics. Clinical evidence of
the benefits of functional mushrooms on digestive health is mounting and led M2 to invest in this
area of research. M2’s collaboration with Prodigest has provided scientific evidence supporting the
prebiotic potential of full-spectrum whole mushroom products. Utilizing microbiome samples from
healthy adults in an artificial gut model, the studies demonstrated that M2’s proprietary mushrooms
significantly fostered the growth of beneficial gut bacteria, leading to a cascade of positive
effects. Notably, the mushrooms effectively lowered colonic pH, indicative of lactate production by
*Bifidobacteria*, and avoided adverse effects like bloating. Furthermore, they significantly
elevated short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) production, particularly butyrate, crucial for cognitive
function, gut health, and immunity, suggesting a diverse and active microbiota through
cross-feeding. This was accompanied by a measurable increase in overall microbiota biomass and a
positive shift in microbial species diversity. Beyond these core prebiotic effects, the study also
revealed metabolic outcomes linked to the mushrooms, indicating modulation of various neuroactive
metabolites, suggesting a potential connection between gut health and neurological function.

IMMUNE SUPPORT

M2’s whole  mushroom products influence immune function through the activation of both innate and
adaptive immune responses. Traditional use of species like Reishi, Turkey Tail, and the Royal Sun
mushroom has demonstrated their immunomodulatory capabilities. These mushrooms contain bioactive
compounds that stimulate the body’s initial immune defenses (innate immunity), such as inflammation
and cellular defenses. Simultaneously, they also enhance the development of targeted immune
responses (adaptive immunity), including antibody production. This combined effect strengthens
overall immune system function, contributing to improved health.

health and cognitive function, while Reishi’s exhibit adaptogenic and immunomodulatory effects. 

 

When consumed regularly in as whole mushrooms encompassing the complete range of bioactive

memory, focus, mood and overall brain health. M2 leverages this scientific understanding, offering
both individual species and custom, proprietary blends designed to optimize cognitive health .

## Who We Are

We’re Manegrow, proudly recognized among the Best Mushroom Manufacturers in India.

What started as a small patch of farmland has grown into one of India’s largest mushroom farms.
Being counted among the Best Mushroom Manufacturers in India means we work hard (and a little muddy)
every day to grow produce that’s not just good for you, but good for the planet too.

Our mushrooms now travel to homes, cafés, restaurants, and well-known brands like Amazon Fresh,
BigBasket, DMart, Swiggy, and Lulu. But our goal hasn’t changed — grow them fresh, send them fresh,
and make sure you can taste the difference from one of the Best Mushroom Manufacturers in India.

[2.png]
[Hand harvesting a white button mushroom with a small knife during indoor mushroom cultivation.]

### Why People Choose Us

When people look for the Best Mushroom Manufacturers in India, they choose us because

No pesticides or chemicals, ever.

We deliver everywhere from a single box to a truckload.

Picked when they’re just right, so they’re full of flavor.

Certified by FSSAI and ISO, which means it’s not just fresh, it’s safe.

 •  MANEGROW MUSHROOMS  •  

## How They Get From Our Farm to You

It all begins with rich compost and clean water. In our climate-controlled farms, the mushrooms grow

## MUSHROOMERS is the brand name of MushroomAg Private Limited

We're passionate about harnessing the power of sustainable agriculture to drive positive change. Our
pioneering approach combines cutting-edge technology with social impact, empowering marginal farmers
and differently abled youth to thrive.

## About Us

#### Our Mission

We're revolutionizing the mushroom industry by creating a sustainable ecosystem that supports
marginalized farmers, visually challenged, and differently abled youth. Our goal is to make
high-protein, nutritious mushroom-based products accessible to all.



#### Our Initiatives
* Developing a Technology-Enabled Platform for Mushroom Farming Lifecycle and Agribusiness Ecosystem
  Management
* Organic mushroom cultivation (presently 5 farming units) with plans to set up 40 mushroom farming
  polyhouses
* Procurement of raw mushrooms from trained marginal farmers
* Mushroom-based processed products (mushroom chips, protein bars, crispies, jerkies, dried
  mushrooms)
* Setting up a Mushroom-Based New Food Product and Processing Unit
* Providing mushroom training to local marginal farmers



#### The Problem We're Solving
* Limited availability of high-protein meat substitutes for vegetarians and vegans
* Seasonal availability of mushrooms due to lack of large-scale cultivation and spawn
* Limited varieties of mushrooms and high-protein snacks
* High prices and limited outlets for mushrooms



#### Our Solutions
* Mass production of mushrooms through backward integration with marginalized farmers and FPOs
* Affordable, commercial-quality spawn production
* Growing 8-9 varieties of mushrooms with minimal investment
* Setting up commercially viable processing units for mushroom-based products
* Creating multiple channels for delivery and increasing outlets through engagement of visually
  challenged and differently abled youth



#### Testimonials
* TotalStart, Accel Partners, Hughes Systique, and others are excited about our steady progress and
  willing to support our efforts for the next several years through their differently abled
  engagement action program.
* They have been supporting us for the last 4 years to help build the organization.



#### What's Next?
* **Building a Mushroom Farming Lifecycle Management Solution**: With visually challenged youth at
  the core, engaging all players to provide inputs to marginalized mushroom farmers and sell their
  output.
* **We Need Your Suppor**t: Join us in empowering visually challenged youth and marginal farmers,
  and creating a sustainable mushroom farming ecosystem.

Incubation Foundation IIT Kharagpur (ABIF IIT KGP), solidified through a Memorandum of Understanding

## About Us

#### Our Mission

We're revolutionizing the mushroom industry by creating a sustainable ecosystem that supports
marginalized farmers, visually challenged, and differently abled youth. Our goal is to make
high-protein, nutritious mushroom-based products accessible to all.



#### Our Initiatives
* Developing a Technology-Enabled Platform for Mushroom Farming Lifecycle and Agribusiness Ecosystem
  Management
* Organic mushroom cultivation (presently 5 farming units) with plans to set up 40 mushroom farming
  polyhouses
* Procurement of raw mushrooms from trained marginal farmers
* Mushroom-based processed products (mushroom chips, protein bars, crispies, jerkies, dried
  mushrooms)
* Setting up a Mushroom-Based New Food Product and Processing Unit
* Providing mushroom training to local marginal farmers



#### The Problem We're Solving
* Limited availability of high-protein meat substitutes for vegetarians and vegans
* Seasonal availability of mushrooms due to lack of large-scale cultivation and spawn
* Limited varieties of mushrooms and high-protein snacks
* High prices and limited outlets for mushrooms



#### Our Solutions
* Mass production of mushrooms through backward integration with marginalized farmers and FPOs
* Affordable, commercial-quality spawn production
* Growing 8-9 varieties of mushrooms with minimal investment
* Setting up commercially viable processing units for mushroom-based products
* Creating multiple channels for delivery and increasing outlets through engagement of visually
  challenged and differently abled youth

## Vote for your favorite holiday songs

Tell us your top 10 holiday songs, and we'll send you an invitation to our virtual holiday party
where we play the top 100 as voted for by the mushroom crowd. Voting is easy and accessible. [Vote
today! ][39] Tell your friends to do the same! Then tune in at 7 AM Eastern on December 20.

## Welcome

Welcome to Mushroom FM. We're pleased you stopped by.

Mushroom FM is a licensed Internet stream in New Zealand bringing you four decades of magic Mushroom
memories, with music from the 50s to the 80s. When you need something on at work that plays music
everyone's familiar with presented by engaging personalities, when you want to hear a station that
plays songs to make you sing and smile, and all commercial-free with the exception of the occasional
old ad we might play for nostalgia, you've come to the right place.

If you lived the music of the time, you'll appreciate that we go way beyond the usual few gold
tracks you'll hear elsewhere. Our music library is extensive. We care about the quality, so we take
care to choose the full album cuts where we can, and the best masters currently available. Plus, we
sound fantastic on a good audio system.

### The Mushroom FM difference

In an era where you can dial up almost any tune ever recorded, the value we add is in our fun,
friendly on-air team, and in the carefully chosen music selection. When we can, we bring you radio
where the personality makes a difference. When that's not possible, the automated mix from all of
our four decades is fresh and eclectic.

### Your memories are as diverse as our music

Sometimes we get asked if we're an easy listening station, a countries station, a pop station or a
rock station? The answer to that is, yes... We're all those things. We're obsessed with those four
great, influential, transformative decades in music. So if it was recorded then, we'll play it.

Our model for our music format is The Beatles themselves. Were the Beatles a band that recorded
standards, pop hits, heavy rock or show tunes? Well, they did all that and more. So let the music
take you on a magical mystery tour. We predict you're never more than a song or two away from one of
your all-time favourites.

### Join the family

The Mushroom FM family consists of great listeners like you who we affectionately call The Mushroom
Crowd, without whom there'd be no point in it all, as well as our knowledgeable and friendly team of
presenters, who we call the fun guys. Our fun guys are all over the globe, including in New Zealand,
Australia, Britain, South Africa, Canada and the US. We love hearing from you about what we're
doing, what we're saying, and what we're playing.

### No matter where you go, there we are

It's super easy to listen to Mushroom FM, whether you're at home, at the office, or on the move.
Choose the Play Mushroom FM link right on this page. You'll find us in all the good radio apps,
including iTunes, TuneIn, Ootunes, myTuner Radio and many more. We're built right into the Victor
Reader Stream and Leasey Radio as well.

Got an Amazon Echo or a Google Home? We have our very own Alexa skill and Google action. No need to
rely on any third party. Just say, "Alexa, open Mushroom FM", or "Hey Google, ask Mushroom FM to
play".

We're best buds with the assistant on your smartphone as well. Just instruct Siri or Google
Assistant on your phone to "play Mushroom FM".

## Vote for your favorite holiday songs

Tell us your top 10 holiday songs, and we'll send you an invitation to our virtual holiday party
where we play the top 100 as voted for by the mushroom crowd. Voting is easy and accessible. [Vote
today! ][39] Tell your friends to do the same! Then tune in at 7 AM Eastern on December 20.

## Welcome

Welcome to Mushroom FM. We're pleased you stopped by.

Mushroom FM is a licensed Internet stream in New Zealand bringing you four decades of magic Mushroom
memories, with music from the 50s to the 80s. When you need something on at work that plays music
everyone's familiar with presented by engaging personalities, when you want to hear a station that
plays songs to make you sing and smile, and all commercial-free with the exception of the occasional
old ad we might play for nostalgia, you've come to the right place.

If you lived the music of the time, you'll appreciate that we go way beyond the usual few gold
tracks you'll hear elsewhere. Our music library is extensive. We care about the quality, so we take
care to choose the full album cuts where we can, and the best masters currently available. Plus, we
sound fantastic on a good audio system.

### The Mushroom FM difference

In an era where you can dial up almost any tune ever recorded, the value we add is in our fun,
friendly on-air team, and in the carefully chosen music selection. When we can, we bring you radio
where the personality makes a difference. When that's not possible, the automated mix from all of
our four decades is fresh and eclectic.

### Your memories are as diverse as our music

Sometimes we get asked if we're an easy listening station, a countries station, a pop station or a
rock station? The answer to that is, yes... We're all those things. We're obsessed with those four
great, influential, transformative decades in music. So if it was recorded then, we'll play it.

Our model for our music format is The Beatles themselves. Were the Beatles a band that recorded
standards, pop hits, heavy rock or show tunes? Well, they did all that and more. So let the music
take you on a magical mystery tour. We predict you're never more than a song or two away from one of
your all-time favourites.

### Join the family

The Mushroom FM family consists of great listeners like you who we affectionately call The Mushroom
Crowd, without whom there'd be no point in it all, as well as our knowledgeable and friendly team of
presenters, who we call the fun guys. Our fun guys are all over the globe, including in New Zealand,
Australia, Britain, South Africa, Canada and the US. We love hearing from you about what we're
doing, what we're saying, and what we're playing.

### No matter where you go, there we are

It's super easy to listen to Mushroom FM, whether you're at home, at the office, or on the move.
Choose the Play Mushroom FM link right on this page. You'll find us in all the good radio apps,
including iTunes, TuneIn, Ootunes, myTuner Radio and many more. We're built right into the Victor
Reader Stream and Leasey Radio as well.

Got an Amazon Echo or a Google Home? We have our very own Alexa skill and Google action. No need to
rely on any third party. Just say, "Alexa, open Mushroom FM", or "Hey Google, ask Mushroom FM to
play".

We're best buds with the assistant on your smartphone as well. Just instruct Siri or Google
Assistant on your phone to "play Mushroom FM".

Sonos? We love Sonos! Search for us there via TuneIn or Sonos Radio.

We love engaging with The Mushroom Crowd via social media. The best way to be a part of the

You can also follow the official [Mushroom FM Mastodon account ][40]for show announcements and other

### Mushroom FM? What?

So settle back, crank it up, and enjoy the best four decades music ever produced, because Mushroom

dramatically different depending on age, moisture, and elevation. Think of an AI result as the kind
of working hypothesis an experienced forager would form in the first few minutes of careful
observation — a strong starting point that still needs to be checked against spore print color,
bruising reactions, smell, and, when in doubt, advice from a qualified local expert.

## What Photos Produce the Most Accurate Mushroom Identification

The quality and variety of your images are the single biggest factor in getting a precise result
from a **mushroom identifier**. A single overhead shot of the cap rarely contains enough information
to distinguish species confidently. A comprehensive set of photos takes about two minutes to capture
and makes a substantial difference in accuracy.

**Start with the cap.** Photograph it from directly above in natural, even light — overcast days are
ideal because harsh sunlight creates shadows that obscure surface detail. Then crouch to capture a
full side profile showing how the cap edge curls, lifts, or droops.

**Turn the mushroom over.** The underside — gills, pores, spines, or wrinkles — is frequently the
most diagnostic feature of the entire specimen. Get close enough to show the attachment point where
the gills or pores meet the stem.

**Photograph the stem base.** Dig gently around the base before pulling the mushroom out. Some
species have a cup-shaped volva or basal bulb that is completely hidden at ground level. Missing
this detail can lead to a misread, particularly with *Amanita* species.

**Include a habitat frame.** Step back and capture the mushroom in context: surrounding leaf litter,
nearby tree trunks, log substrate, or moss. This environmental view is often as revealing as the
specimen itself, especially when paired with a location note.

## How to use Mushroom Identifier
1. 1
   
   ### Upload Multiple Angles
   
   Click "Upload Images" to add up to 6 photos. Capture the cap from above, the full side profile,
   and the base emerging from the ground. More angles mean a more accurate match.
2. 2
   
   ### Photograph the Underside
   
   Flip the cap to show what's beneath — gills, pores, or teeth. This single view is often the
   fastest way to narrow the species. Tip: a photo in the shade reduces glare on the gills.
3. 3
   
   ### Set the Date Found
   
   Update the Date Found field to the day you spotted it. Seasonality is a key identifier — many
   species fruit only in spring, summer, or fall, so timing helps rule out look-alikes.
4. 4
   
   ### Add Location & Habitat Context
   
   Enter where it was found — a town, park, or trail name is enough. Note nearby trees, ground
   cover, or whether it was growing on wood or soil. Habitat is often as important as the photo
   itself.
5. 5
   
   ### Review Results & Stay Safe
   
   Press "Identify Mushroom" to start the analysis and review your results. Use them as a starting
   point only — never make edibility decisions based on an AI result alone. When in doubt, consult a
   local mycologist.

## How a Mushroom Identifier Works

A modern **mushroom identifier** uses artificial intelligence trained on hundreds of thousands of
labeled fungal specimens. When you upload an image, the system extracts visual features — cap shape,
color, surface texture, gill pattern, stem structure — and compares them against a database of known
species to return a ranked list of likely matches.

What separates a reliable **mushroom identifier** from a basic image search is context-awareness.
The AI does not simply look at color in isolation; it weighs combinations of structural traits
together. A brown cap with free gills and a stem ring tells a very different story than a brown cap
with decurrent gills and no ring. These compound patterns allow the model to distinguish species
that look nearly identical at a glance.

Location and seasonality data sharpen accuracy further. Many fungi share overlapping ranges, so
knowing whether a specimen appeared in a Pacific Northwest conifer forest versus a Midwestern oak
woodland meaningfully narrows the candidate pool.

Keep in mind that results reflect visual probability, not certainty. The same species can look
dramatically different depending on age, moisture, and elevation. Think of an AI result as the kind
of working hypothesis an experienced forager would form in the first few minutes of careful
observation — a strong starting point that still needs to be checked against spore print color,
bruising reactions, smell, and, when in doubt, advice from a qualified local expert.

## What Photos Produce the Most Accurate Mushroom Identification

The quality and variety of your images are the single biggest factor in getting a precise result
from a **mushroom identifier**. A single overhead shot of the cap rarely contains enough information
to distinguish species confidently. A comprehensive set of photos takes about two minutes to capture
and makes a substantial difference in accuracy.

**Start with the cap.** Photograph it from directly above in natural, even light — overcast days are
ideal because harsh sunlight creates shadows that obscure surface detail. Then crouch to capture a
full side profile showing how the cap edge curls, lifts, or droops.

**Turn the mushroom over.** The underside — gills, pores, spines, or wrinkles — is frequently the
most diagnostic feature of the entire specimen. Get close enough to show the attachment point where
the gills or pores meet the stem.

**Photograph the stem base.** Dig gently around the base before pulling the mushroom out. Some
species have a cup-shaped volva or basal bulb that is completely hidden at ground level. Missing
this detail can lead to a misread, particularly with *Amanita* species.

**Include a habitat frame.** Step back and capture the mushroom in context: surrounding leaf litter,
nearby tree trunks, log substrate, or moss. This environmental view is often as revealing as the
specimen itself, especially when paired with a location note.

## The Role of Habitat in Mushroom Identification

Fungi do not exist in isolation. Nearly every mushroom species has evolved a specific ecological
relationship — with particular tree families, soil types, decaying wood, or living root systems —
and those relationships are essential context for narrowing down what you have found.

## How the psilocybin are made

Psilocybin is a naturally occurring psychedelic compound produced by over 200 species of mushrooms,
primarily within the Psilocybe genus. The biosynthesis of psilocybin starts with the amino acid
tryptophan, which is converted into tryptamine by the enzyme tryptophan decarboxylase. Tryptamine is
then hydroxylated by tryptamine 4-hydroxylase to form psilocin. Psilocin, the active psychoactive
compound, is subsequently phosphorylated by psilocybin synthase, resulting in the formation of
psilocybin.

## How the psilocybin are made

Psilocybin is a naturally occurring psychedelic compound produced by over 200 species of mushrooms,
primarily within the Psilocybe genus. The biosynthesis of psilocybin starts with the amino acid
tryptophan, which is converted into tryptamine by the enzyme tryptophan decarboxylase. Tryptamine is
then hydroxylated by tryptamine 4-hydroxylase to form psilocin. Psilocin, the active psychoactive
compound, is subsequently phosphorylated by psilocybin synthase, resulting in the formation of
psilocybin.

## Our Story

Changing the Game

Vibrational sound healing instruments such as singing bowls, gongs and bells have been around for
thousands of years and used in many different cultures both for healing and ritual purposes.  The
way these instruments have been played has remained mostly unchanged during this time.  We believe
that the digital era we live in has enabled new technologies which can be harnessed to enhance these
time-honored instruments while preserving their traditional essence.  Our mission is to introduce
new technologies aimed at enhancing the experience while making these instruments accessible to a
broader group of practitioners in an effort to help raise our global vibrations. 

"The best way to predict the future is to create it"

## Our Technology

A new Interaction Paradigm

Our patent pending flagship product, the Musical Mushroom®, enables sound practitioners to control
their singing bowls or similar resonant instruments using simple hand gestures using a small
removable exciter coil glued to the inside surface of the bowl.  This new approach replaces the use
of the traditional mallet.  Electro-mechanical vibrations excite the bowl at its resonant
frequencies under the guidance of the performer, whether in close proximity using hand gestures or
via wired (USB) control using the MIDI protocol.  One of the many benefits of replacing the mallet
includes the ability to physically extend the performer's range, as well as to automatically hold a
drone note while the performer is free to simultaneously play other bowls or instruments.

[Illustration of how the Musical Mushroom works in a crystal singing bowl]

A novel hand gesture sensor enables local interactions using the performer's hands hovering over the
bowl.  The measured hand position above the bowl is used to modulate the sound volume.  This fluid
up-and-down movement is very intuitive and replaces the circular movement of the mallet.  This
enables a new way of interacting and playing with this traditional instrument.


Finally, the ability to wirelessly network multiple bowls during a performance enables the artist to
spread bowls across an audience and control them all via a central location instead of being
restricted to the arm's length mallet reach, giving the spectators a more visceral experience of
lying down between bowls during a sound bath performance.  Add some super cool LED lighting effects
such as the candle flicker and you have an engaging audio-visual performance!

[A Musical Mushroom automated singing bowl controller installed in a crystal singing bowl.]

How Does it Work?

In local interaction mode, an invisible infrared light beam is emitted vertically above the unit to
measure the distance from the Musical Mushroom's® top surface to a hand hovering above the bowl. 
The presence of a hand will cause the bowl to vibrate constantly at its resonant frequency for as
long as the hand is present. top of page

## Our Story

Changing the Game

Vibrational sound healing instruments such as singing bowls, gongs and bells have been around for
thousands of years and used in many different cultures both for healing and ritual purposes.  The
way these instruments have been played has remained mostly unchanged during this time.  We believe
that the digital era we live in has enabled new technologies which can be harnessed to enhance these
time-honored instruments while preserving their traditional essence.  Our mission is to introduce
new technologies aimed at enhancing the experience while making these instruments accessible to a
broader group of practitioners in an effort to help raise our global vibrations. 

"The best way to predict the future is to create it"

## Abraham Lincoln

[A stack of Musical Mushroom automated singing bowl controllers on a table.]

## Our Technology

A new Interaction Paradigm

Our patent pending flagship product, the Musical Mushroom®, enables sound practitioners to control
their singing bowls or similar resonant instruments using simple hand gestures using a small
removable exciter coil glued to the inside surface of the bowl.  This new approach replaces the use
of the traditional mallet.  Electro-mechanical vibrations excite the bowl at its resonant
frequencies under the guidance of the performer, whether in close proximity using hand gestures or
via wired (USB) control using the MIDI protocol.  One of the many benefits of replacing the mallet
includes the ability to physically extend the performer's range, as well as to automatically hold a
drone note while the performer is free to simultaneously play other bowls or instruments.

[Illustration of how the Musical Mushroom works in a crystal singing bowl]

A novel hand gesture sensor enables local interactions using the performer's hands hovering over the
bowl.  The measured hand position above the bowl is used to modulate the sound volume.  This fluid
up-and-down movement is very intuitive and replaces the circular movement of the mallet.  This
enables a new way of interacting and playing with this traditional instrument.


Finally, the ability to wirelessly network multiple bowls during a performance enables the artist to
spread bowls across an audience and control them all via a central location instead of being
restricted to the arm's length mallet reach, giving the spectators a more visceral experience of
lying down between bowls during a sound bath performance.  Add some super cool LED lighting effects
such as the candle flicker and you have an engaging audio-visual performance!

[A Musical Mushroom automated singing bowl controller installed in a crystal singing bowl.]

How Does it Work?

In local interaction mode, an invisible infrared light beam is emitted vertically above the unit to
measure the distance from the Musical Mushroom's® top surface to a hand hovering above the bowl. 
The presence of a hand will cause the bowl to vibrate constantly at its resonant frequency for as
long as the hand is present.  The closer the hand is to the bowl, the louder the sound.  Moving the
hand up and down causes a pleasing tremolo effect, modulating the amplitude similar to the effect
produced by a traditional mallet moving around the rim of the bowl.


In addition, the Musical Mushroom® will automatically detect the hand movement pattern, whether
waving or in a fixed position and will continue it indefinitely when the hand is removed.  This is
useful for generating an automatic drone note effect, enabling the performer to move to playing
other bowls without needing to constantly keep the bowl resonating.  To stop the bowl, the hand is
simply waved in and out of the beam quickly.

How Do I Use It?

There are many creative ways to use the Musical Mushrooms® in a performance.  Whether they are used
to simply drive one or two automatic drone notes in the background to accompany you while you play
your key bowls manually.  You can automate all your bowls and play them using your hands.  You can
connect two Musical Mushrooms® to a single bowl to independently control the main frequency as well
as the overtone (two tones in one bowl).  You can control your bowls while sitting or standing.  You
can distribute your bowls across your audience and travel between them while playing other
instruments.  The sky's the limit!  We are excited to see what creative uses our users will come up
with!! 

## New Possibilities

We are incredibly excited to see where sound practitioners and healers will take this new technology
enabling innovative ways to incorporate sound healing and performance into their practice! 


We also hope to bring vibrational sound instruments to a new generation of users.

[Musical Mushroom automated singing bowl controllers used in colorful bowls with LED effects during
a live sound bath showing practitioner standing up while playing.]

# MykoWeb:
# Mushrooms & other Fungi on the Web

Welcome to MykoWeb, WWW pages devoted to the science of mycology (the study of the fungi) and the
hobby of mushrooming (the pursuit of mushrooms). It is a production of [Michael Wood][19], a past
president of the [Mycological Society of San Francisco][20]. MykoWeb was started in the fall of 1995
and was one of the first internet mycology mushrooming sites.

## The Fungi of California

The main attraction at MykoWeb is [The Fungi of California][21], an expanded version of the former
"Fungi of the San Francisco Bay Area". [The Fungi of California][22] contains photographs over
**850** species of mushrooms and other fungi found in California, with over **790** of the species
with descriptions. There are currently over **9700** total photographs of the mushrooms. Included
are links to other online descriptions and photos of the species treated plus references to common
field guides. Also included is a [Glossary][23] of mycological terms and a [Bibliography][24] of
useful mycological references. [The Fungi of California][25] is a joint project of Michael Wood and
Fred Stevens.

## Reprinted Books

MykoWeb has republished four books that are mycological treasures, but long out of print in book
form. The first appears here as [The Boletes of California.][26] This is an online reprint of
*California Mushrooms: A Field Guide to the Boletes* by Dr. Harry D. Thiers. Here you will find keys
and descriptions of the 85 species and varieties of Bolete mushrooms known from California when the
book was published in 1975. [The Boletes of California][27] was done with the permission of Dr.
Harry Thiers and the assistance of Fred Stevens and Michael Boom.

"The book is excellent. Thiers is a top-notch writer. More botanists should write for both the
professional and amateur."
(Clark Rogerson, Managing Editor of *Mycologia*, 1975)

MykoWeb has started a series of mushroom monograph reprints. The first, *[The North American Species
of Pholiota][28]*, is now complete. Included are descriptions of 216 taxa of *Pholiota (sensu
lato)*, with illustrations and photographs. Just completed is the [*North American Species of
Crepidotus* ][29]with descriptions, illustrations, and photographs of 139 taxa.

MykoWeb has also republished the fine mushroom cookbook by Louise Freedman: [Wild About Mushrooms:
the Cookbook of the Mycological Society of San Francisco.][30] The book covers the preparation and
preservation of many wild and cultivated mushroom species. Enjoy the abundance of excellent recipes!

## Photos

MykoWeb is a site rich in mushroom photography. There over 10,800 fungal photographs to view, with
over 9600 of these illustrating the species at [The Fungi of California][31]. Hundreds of the best
photographs are available for viewing in large size on the [Mushroom Photography ][32]pages.

## Much, Much More

Michael Wood is also the creator and former WebMaster of the [Mycological Society of San
Francisco][33] website and served as WebMaster of the North American Mycological Association website
for over four years. Included at MykoWeb is a list of all the amateur [mushroom clubs][34] in North
America, with mailing addresses, web site information, and email contacts.

A mycoblitz is a quick, intense survey of the mushroom and other fungal species present. At the [Pt.
Reyes MycoBlitz][35] pages you can learn about the study of that area that is in progress.
Eventually there will be photos and collection information on all the [voucher specimens][36]
collected in the study.

Other parts of MykoWeb include a page of [Wild Mushroom Recipes][37]. On the [Mushroom Articles][38]
page you will find some fine writing by Steve Trudell (mycorrhiza & book reviews), Mike Boom (fungal
lust!) and Terri Beausejour (cultivation) and many others. Finally there is the [Miscellanea][39]
page. There you can find what does not fit elsewhere, including watercolors, quotes and plates from
old mushroom books, mushroom humor, and several bibliographies, including a copy of my [Bibliography
of the Hypogeous and Secotioid Fungi][40].

The photographs throughout MykoWeb are copyrighted by the photographers who took them and are used
here with their permission. For more information, see [**Use of Photographs at MykoWeb**][41]

Many thanks to all who have helped with these pages. Very special thanks to Fred Stevens, Mike Boom,
and [Taylor F. Lockwood][42].

Thank you for visiting MykoWeb.

## Aloha Medicinals Inc. is world’s largest and most technologically advanced producer of USDA and
## EU Certified Organic medicinal mushrooms.

Aloha Medicinals Inc. is one of the largest and most technologically advanced producers of USDA and
EU Certified Organic medicinal mushrooms and mushroom-derived compounds in the world today. All of
the Aloha Medicinals' raw materials are produced in the United States in Carson City, Nevada under
FDA certified Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) regulations, licensed by the State of Nevada as a
food manufacturing plant, fully certified 100% Organic under USDA and EU regulations. All Aloha

# Welcome to the Shroomery!

We help spread accurate information about magic mushrooms so people can make informed decisions
about what they put in their bodies. You can learn about the [effects of shrooms][168] and read
[trip reports][169], find out how to [grow mushrooms][170] and get [mushroom recipes][171], browse
through the [gallery][172] and hang out on our [message board][173], or check out the [site
map][174] for everything the Shroomery has to offer.

You are invited to [contact us][175] with any comments, suggestions or criticism. The Shroomery is
constantly under construction and we rely on your input in order to continue to improve it. Most
importantly, enjoy the site! We look forward to welcoming you into our community.

You must be 18 years old to use this site. [Note to parents][176].
By visiting the Shroomery you agree to be bound by our [disclaimer][177] and [privacy policy][178].

# Stan & Joyce Orchard

Trying to figure it out since 1975.

[[Our Newest Neighbor]][9]

## [Our Newest Neighbor][10]

Mom decided to rest outside our living room window.

[[Unbearable Visitor]][11]

## [Unbearable Visitor][12]

This big guy wandered in at sunset. No matter how much I yelled he just looked at me as if to say,
'relax, dude. I'll leave when I'm ready.' Uppity jerk.

[[Fuzzy Antler Time]][13]

## [Fuzzy Antler Time][14]

These two guys and some of their friends stopped by early this morning. Always fascinated by their
seasonal changes, summer coats and new antlers coming in. Nature is always the best show in town.

[[Gruesome Find]][15]

## [Gruesome Find][16]

Found this in our front yard this morning. An eagle? A hawk? Not sure. A coyote or something else
caught it on that little rise then chewed on it until abandoning it where it is now. Gruesome yet
fascinating.

[[Hoping For Sheds]][17]

## [Hoping For Sheds][18]

We had about 20 of our furry friends stop by this afternoon. Most were cows but a few young bulls as
well. The guy in front still has his antlers, but the guy in back has already dropped his. We'll be
out looking.

[[Firewood Season Begins]][19]

## [Firewood Season Begins][20]

Changed the oil in the splitter and split one of the rounds we cut last fall. Should be done by
August. Now, I need a nap.

[[Bull In The Woods]][21]

## [Bull In The Woods][22]

Spotted this guy in the watershed at the end of our road on my walk today. Hasn’t dropped his rack
yet and his winter coat is still shaggy. That will all change soon.

[[Snow Day!]][23]

## [Snow Day!][24]

First halfway serious snow around here in the past two years. Limbs are cracking, trees snapping.
Haven't seen this in a while. Hopefully it will be gone soon.

[[Some Friends Stopped By]][25]

## [Some Friends Stopped By][26]

These critters and around 30+ of their friends wandered through. After more than 40 years they still

# Stan & Joyce Orchard

Trying to figure it out since 1975.

[[Our Newest Neighbor]][9]

## [Our Newest Neighbor][10]

Mom decided to rest outside our living room window.

[[Unbearable Visitor]][11]

## [Unbearable Visitor][12]

This big guy wandered in at sunset. No matter how much I yelled he just looked at me as if to say,
'relax, dude. I'll leave when I'm ready.' Uppity jerk.

[[Fuzzy Antler Time]][13]

## [Fuzzy Antler Time][14]

These two guys and some of their friends stopped by early this morning. Always fascinated by their
seasonal changes, summer coats and new antlers coming in. Nature is always the best show in town.

[[Gruesome Find]][15]

## [Gruesome Find][16]

Found this in our front yard this morning. An eagle? A hawk? Not sure. A coyote or something else
caught it on that little rise then chewed on it until abandoning it where it is now. Gruesome yet
fascinating.

[[Hoping For Sheds]][17]

## [Hoping For Sheds][18]

We had about 20 of our furry friends stop by this afternoon. Most were cows but a few young bulls as
well. The guy in front still has his antlers, but the guy in back has already dropped his. We'll be
out looking.

[[Firewood Season Begins]][19]

## [Firewood Season Begins][20]

Changed the oil in the splitter and split one of the rounds we cut last fall. Should be done by
August. Now, I need a nap.

[[Bull In The Woods]][21]

## [Bull In The Woods][22]

Spotted this guy in the watershed at the end of our road on my walk today. Hasn’t dropped his rack
yet and his winter coat is still shaggy. That will all change soon.

[[Snow Day!]][23]

## [Snow Day!][24]

First halfway serious snow around here in the past two years. Limbs are cracking, trees snapping.
Haven't seen this in a while. Hopefully it will be gone soon.

[[Some Friends Stopped By]][25]

## [Some Friends Stopped By][26]

These critters and around 30+ of their friends wandered through. After more than 40 years they still
fascinate us. Wonder what they think of us?

[[A Life Illuminated]][27]

## [A Life Illuminated][28]

On this day long ago in the Territory of Alaska on the darkest day of the year, a child was born.
She became and is still the light of my life. We’re both amazed and grateful to still be here. Merry
Christmas everyone!

## What is Online Case Study?

[Online Case Study][Online Case Study]A methodology of creating a systematic research related to any
professional experience or any specific incident is commonly referred to as case study. In other
words, a case study is a method of encouraging students of different courses to participate in the
real life scenarios and have a practical experience of professional life through assessing it from
different perspectives. Case study is subjective and descriptive analysis of a group, person or any
event.

Online case studies are available on the internet for students to practice writing a report on a
given case study and to learn more about the different types of case studies available. It is also
available for educators to provide students with different and informative case study and to educate
them through it.

As students are not practically involved in the professional life and have only bookish knowledge
thus, to give them a practical and professional life experience, almost every university incorporate

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.

co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.
